svg.title: Train / Test Split with test size 0.25, stratified on churn and seed 42, sends 12 of the 16 customers to training, 6 churned and 6 stayed, and holds out customers 3, 8, 13 and 14, 2 of each. The model learns only from the 12 training rows; Predict and Evaluate score the 4 test rows.
svg.text: the test rows stay out of training
